an4.238:1.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni katamāni cattāri atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati. katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ
an4.238:1.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
an4.238:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ.
an4.238:3.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.238:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ.
an4.238:4.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati
an4.238:4.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo
an4.238:4.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.238:4.4: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
